description: This file implements a wrapper for the Linux inotify system, providing functionality to create, manage, and read filesystem event watches on Linux systems. It defines methods for adding, removing, and handling inotify watches, and includes event processing logic.

classes.name: Watcher
classes.description: Represents an inotify watcher instance, managing file system watches and event channels.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents a filesystem event detected by inotify, including event mask, name, and cookie.

methods.name: NewWatcher
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new inotify watcher instance.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the inotify watcher, stopping event reading and removing watches.

methods.name: AddWatch
methods.description: Adds a filesystem path to the watch list with specified event flags.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Adds a path to the watch list for all events.

methods.name: RemoveWatch
methods.description: Removes a path from the watch list.

methods.name: readEvents
methods.description: Continuously reads filesystem events from the inotify file descriptor and dispatches them.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Formats an Event object into a human-readable string.
